name: Etherealwinds Harp II CE
credit: Etherealwinds Harp II: Community Edition by Jordi Francis (etherealwinds) and Versilian Studios (CC BY 4.0): a 34-string Iona Celtic harp, sampled chromatically.

source.note: The harp's WAVs, taken out of the published zip, each kept until it falls to -60 dB (12 s at most) and faded there, otherwise bit for bit.
